statement: Pinned xpadneo matches Bluetooth Series vendor 0x045e/product 0x0b13, but its probe normalizes the HID-visible identity to vendor 0x045e/product 0x028e and version 0x1130 before HID parsing. That post-driver identity can differ from the source controller identity and influence downstream application detection; no particular SDL runtime outcome was measured.

applicability.revision: standard Xbox Series controller, model 1914, with explicitly labelled older/Elite comparators
applicability.scope: core.c:48-71, 169-241; treat identity translation as xpadneo behavior rather than a Series Bluetooth hardware identity.
